items.title: Chandrayaan programme
items.snippet_en: The Chandrayaan-3 mission successfully landed on the Moon on August 23, 2023, making India the first nation to successfully land a spacecraft in the lunar south pole region, and the fourth country to land on the Moon.

items.title: Chandrayaan-3
items.snippet_en: Chandrayaan-3 touched down near the lunar south pole, at 69°S, on August 23, 2023, at 18:04 IST (12:33 UTC). The mission consists of Vikram, a lunar lander, and Pragyan, a lunar rover.

items.title: India becomes only the 4th country to successfully land a spacecraft on the moon
items.snippet_en: India landed a spacecraft near the moon's south pole on August 23, 2023, becoming the first country to touch down near the little-explored south pole region. This makes India the fourth country to achieve a moon landing.

items.title: India Becomes First Nation to Land Craft on Moon's South Pole
items.snippet_en: India successfully placed a lander in the moon's southern polar region on August 23, 2023, making history as the first country to touch down on an uncharted part of the lunar surface. No country had previously made a soft landing on the south pole.

items.title: India lands spacecraft near south pole of moon in historic first
items.snippet_en: India became the first country to successfully land a spacecraft near the south pole of the moon, with the Chandrayaan-3 spacecraft's Vikram lander touching down shortly after 6 pm (1230 BST) near the lunar south pole.

items.title: India makes history with its first Moon landing
items.snippet_en: On August 23, 2023, the Indian Space Research Organization's (ISRO) Chandrayaan-3 mission landed near the Moon's south pole. India is the first country to land on the Moon since 2020 and joins the U.S., Russia, and China as lunar visitors.
